# VulkanMod Reforged 0.3.5-ALPHA
-# Minecraft 1.21.1 | NeoForge

This update restores Essential's interface and previews, fixes upside-down loading backgrounds, and addresses several mod compatibility crashes.

## Compatibility Changes

### Essential
- Added support for Essential 1.5.1's updated interface renderer
- Fixed missing or corrupted menu text and interface elements
- Fixed upside-down buttons and overlays
- Fixed blank Wardrobe player previews and bundle previews
- Corrected clipping when rendering players into offscreen textures
- Fixed texture-size checks attempting unnecessary GPU allocations

### Veil and Sable
- Fixed a crash caused by unavailable shader matrix uniforms
- Corrected shader-stage handling for supported Veil rendering paths
- Checked powered Aeronautics burner rendering with Sable and Veil

### Simply Swords and SimplyTooltips
- Fixed tooltips leaving other inventory items greyed out
- Restored rendering state after tooltip and item-preview drawing

### Scorched Guns
- Fixed a startup compatibility crash with the Scorched Guns 1.0.2 port
- Updated rendering-hook detection to handle differences between versions

## Rendering Changes
- Unified viewport orientation handling across screen and offscreen targets
- Corrected positioning for partial viewports
- Preserved viewport state when switching or restoring render targets
- Fixed framebuffer activation when a mod attaches its textures after binding the framebuffer
- Preserved the screen's orientation when another framebuffer shares its color texture

## Bugs Fixed
- Blurred world-loading panoramas appearing upside down
- Offscreen previews being clipped using window coordinates
- Crashes involving missing texture uploads
- Repeated resize callbacks causing rendering re-entry
- Incorrect viewport dimensions being returned to mods

## Known Issues
- Tutorial notifications may flicker in the Essential Wardrobe
- Further performance optimization is still in progress
- Moving Sable assemblies require additional testing
- Full compatibility with every modpack has not been verified

Install the production JAR for Minecraft 1.21.1 with NeoForge. Source archives are provided separately. See SHA256SUMS.txt for download checksums.
